title: SMRTnet predicts small molecules that bind RNA
summary: Across 10 disease-associated RNA targets the model yielded 40 hits with nanomolar to micromolar affinity; one compound was tested in three cancer cell lines.
organization: Tsinghua University, Peking University and China Pharmaceutical University

evidence.tested: Predicted small molecules tested for binding to 10 disease-associated RNA targets, giving 40 hits with nanomolar to micromolar affinity; one compound tested in three cancer cell lines.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: a press-release hit rate of 21.1% was not checked against the paper.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning model fusing two large language models with convolutional and graph attention networks to predict small molecule-RNA binding from RNA secondary structure.
